title: Silver-dotted titanium dioxide nanocomposites for highly efficient photo-induced enhanced Raman spectroscopy in trace detection of weak-Raman-response molecules
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41270-41285
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05258K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Quan-Doan Mai, Dang Thi Hanh Trang, Vo Thi Le Na, Ta Ngoc Bach, Ong Van Hoang, Nguyen Thi Thanh Tuyen, Nguyen Duy Hung, Anh-Tuan Pham, Anh-Tuan Le
In this work, a photo-induced enhanced Raman spectroscopy (PIERS) platform based on Ag-dotted TiO2 nanocomposites was developed to overcome the limitations of conventional SERS in detecting weak-Raman-response molecules.
